description: Platform-neutral runtime renderer, contracts, and helpers for Ankhorage generated apps.

usageEntries.title: Basic Usage
usageEntries.description:
`@ankhorage/runtime` owns platform-neutral runtime renderer contracts for generated apps.

Host apps keep router, theme, and other framework-specific behavior outside this package and
inject it at the runtime boundary.

<RuntimeRenderer
                key={`${child.id}:${String(repeatKey)}`}
                node={child}
                registry={effectiveRegistry}
                bindingContext={createRuntimeRepeatBindingContext({
                  baseContext: effectiveConfig.bindingContext,
                  item,
                  itemAlias,
                })}
              />

<RuntimeRenderer
      key={`${screen.id}:${screenOperationLoaders.renderVersion}`}
      node={screen.root}
      isRoot
      registry={registry}
      stateAdapter={stateAdapter}
      dataBindings={manifest.dataBindings}
      mediaAssets={manifest.media?.assets}
      resultSlots={screenOperationLoaders.resultSlots}
      executeCapability={executeCapability}
    />
